budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Rescue six individually conserved survivors while protecting crews and managing finite water. Every rescue has shared value and extra value to its actual rescuer and the survivor-index priority role.
task.natural_termination: All six survivors are resolved as rescued or lost, or all three crew health values are zero. Surviving unresolved civilians remain in the final state when all crews are disabled. Otherwise truncate at 120 live steps.
task.interaction: Cleared fuel blocks future orthogonal ignition, spraying changes immediate hazards, and directed water gifts change a partner resource budget. Survivor custody is exclusive and can be relayed by dropping then picking. A common finite tank, occupied cells and priorities couple rescue decisions.
task.observation_access: Fully observable public fire, fuel, smoke, people, supplies and events. Flat cell arrays are row-major duplicates of the corresponding native grids; fixed cell positions are determined by the public 9-by-7 grid. Visibility masks are all true. Lost survivors become inactive; their loss and final health remain in the observation.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Survivor first reached the safe corner this turn
Survivor reached zero health this turn
Crew lost one health this turn
A successful clear vote reached this unburning ground cell
Water units sprayed into each cell this turn
Crew took one tank unit this turn
Crew gave one unit to its facing ally this turn

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
